settings.title: Live settings
settings.description: Per-school recording retention and capacity limits.
settings.attendanceSyncHint: Mark attendance from live-class presence when a session ends (in-app rooms only).
settings.onlineHint: Deliver every timetable slot as a live class. Sessions are created automatically for each school day.
settings.providerPendingHint: In-app rooms are not provisioned yet. Classes will use external links until they are, then switch over automatically.
settings.modeHint: Timetable classes run at their scheduled period. An open room stays available to the whole section for the school day, with no period boundaries.
settings.windowHint: Open a live class alongside every physical class for these dates — weather, closures, or anything else that keeps students home. The school stays open; this only adds the online channel.
settings.windowUntilHint: Leave the end date empty to stay online until further notice. Clearing the start date ends the period.
settings.windowNotePlaceholder: Shown to staff on this page
settings.fallbackUrlHint: Used for any class with no meeting link of its own — the difference between every class being joinable and nothing being created. It is one shared room; set per-subject links below for separate rooms.

coverage.title: Meeting-link coverage
coverage.summary: {covered} of {total} classes have their own link
coverage.allCovered: Every class has its own meeting link.
coverage.withFallback: These will use the standing link above — a room shared with every other uncovered class:
coverage.withoutFallback: These have no link at all and will not be created. Set a standing link above, or add a link per class:

sectionPolicy.title: Recording opt-out by section
sectionPolicy.description: Sections opted out are never recorded, regardless of the school default.

onlinePolicy.title: Online teaching by section
onlinePolicy.description: Override the school-wide setting for individual sections.
onlinePolicy.overrides: {count} section(s) differ from the school default

settings.recordingUnavailable: Recording is not set up for this school yet — sessions will run without it.
settings.deliveryHint: Decides whether live classes exist at all. Everything below about online delivery follows from this.
settings.deliveryPhysicalHint: Every class in the building. No live rooms, no join buttons.
settings.deliveryOnlineHint: Every timetable slot is a live class, for every section.
settings.deliveryHybridHint: Choose per section, or open a temporary online window.
settings.sectionsDefault: Sections online unless they opt out
settings.sectionsDefaultHint: The default for sections without their own setting below.
settings.takesEffectTomorrow: Applies to new sessions. Today's already-scheduled live classes stay as they are and close on their own.
settings.earlyLeave: Left early if gone before end by (minutes)
settings.thresholdsHint: How presence in the room becomes an attendance mark.
settings.consentNoteHint: Students and guardians see this when they enter a class that is being recorded. Leave empty for the standard sentence.
settings.consentNotePlaceholder: This class is recorded for students who miss it. Your voice and video may appear in the recording.
settings.autoPublish: Publish recordings to the lesson automatically
settings.autoPublishHint: When a recorded class is linked to a Lumos lesson, the recording appears there for the school once it is ready.
settings.guardiansObserveHint: As observers only — no microphone, camera or questions.
settings.joinMuted: Students enter muted with the camera off
settings.joinMutedHint: The teacher can override this per class in the class settings.
settings.toolsHint: What students and teachers can use inside a live class.
settings.reminderLeadHint: The “starting soon” notification goes out this many minutes before a class, on the next reminder run.
settings.protectionHint: School policy, applied everywhere: videos, recordings and materials are viewed in the app and never downloaded; every viewer sees a faint watermark with their identity; picture-in-picture, casting and printing are off.
settings.storageUnlimited: {used} used · no quota on this plan
